# `matrix` command

Build, test and (with `--verify`) run the cases of every fobos mode rebuilt as each shadow, in the environment of
its `[verification] setup` line.

```bash
fobis matrix [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Verifying results](/cookbook/verification).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--modes` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated fobos modes [default: every mode]. |
| `--shadows` | TEXT | `none,checks` | Comma-separated shadows: none (the mode's own flags), checks, sanitize, strict. |
| `--compilers` | TEXT |  | Keep the modes whose compiler (or family: gnu, intel, nvfortran) is listed. |
| `--verify` |  |  | Also run the declared cases: references and cross-cell agreement. |
| `--recheck` |  |  | Run failed tests and cases of a cell again under the checks shadow. |
| `--no-tests` |  |  | Do not run the test programs. |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
